propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during workflow cancellation; jobs with always() predicates remain true and are not canceled even when superseded by a new patchset.

Commit 6f4123678c added always() predicates to seven full-route jobs, causing stale matrix and reusable jobs to run to natural completion instead of being promptly canceled when a new patchset supersedes the run.

The seven full-route job predicates must be replaced with cancellation-aware status checks using !cancelled() to preserve the docs-only contract while ensuring prompt cancellation on same-change replacement.
Classifier failure must remain fail-closed and continue to launch the full fallback route as a blocking result, independent of cancellation status.
The vote and finalization jobs must maintain their cancellation-aware behavior to ensure canceled runs are normalized and reported.
